20261121-physics-g05-2.title: Motokari yakapfuura nzvimbo yekutarisa
20261121-physics-g05-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Motokari yakapfuura nzvimbo yekutarisa kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-physics-g05-2.material: Motokari yakapfuura nzvimbo yekutarisa speed yepamugwagwa mukuru (kureba kwose 30 km) mumaminetsi 15. Speed yepakati yemotokari iyi ndeyemakiromita mangani paawa?
20261121-physics-g05-2.s.s1.prompt: Motokari yakapfuura nzvimbo yekutarisa speed yepamugwagwa mukuru (kureba kwose 30 km) mumaminetsi 15. Speed yepakati yemotokari iyi ndeyemakiromita mangani paawa?
20261121-physics-g05-2.s.s1.explain: $15$ maminetsi ndiwo $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ awa ($\frac{1}{4}$ awa). Speed yepakati ndi $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.

20261118-physics-g06.title: Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe
20261118-physics-g06.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261118-physics-g06.material: Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe, mabhaibhi maviri, uye switch zvakabatanidzwa nemawaya. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chemamiriro e'closed circuit' unoita kuti mabhaibhi abvire?
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.prompt: Tinoda kubatidza mwenje nebhatiri rimwe, mabhaibhi maviri, uye switch zvakabatanidzwa nemawaya. Ndechipi chirevo chakarurama chemamiriro e'closed circuit' unoita kuti mabhaibhi abvire?
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.explain: Kuti current ifambe, pane kudiwa closed circuit inobatanidzwa pasina kutyoka kubva papole imwe yebhatiri, kuburikidza nezvikamu zvemagetsi, kusvika papole yakatarisana nayo.

20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.hint.1: Mapole eplus (+) neminus (-) ebhatiri anofanira kubatanidzwa zvizere.
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.o.o0: Inofanira kubatanidzwa pasina kutyoka kubva pa pole yeplus (+) yebhatiri, kuburikidza ne switch nemabhaibhi, kusvika pa pole yeminus (-)
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.o.o1: Magumo ose ewaya anofanira kubatanidzwa kupole yeplus (+) yebhatiri chete
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.o.o2: Rabha inofanira kuiswa pakati pewaya kuti iunganidze magetsi
20261118-physics-g06.s.s1.o.o3: Switch inofanira kuvhurwa kuti pave nemukaha pakati pewaya

20261121-physics-g06-2.material: Electromagnet yakagadzirwa nokuputira waya yeenamel katanhatu kaviri pamusoro pemsumari wesimbi ichibatanidzwa nebhatiri. Tingaita sei kuti electromagnet iyi inamire ma clip mazhinji (simba rakawanda)?

20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.explain: Kuti simba reelectromagnet rikure, wedzerai nhamba yekuputira coil, kana kuwedzera mabhatiri mu series kuti current inofamba mu circuit ikure.
20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.0: Simba reelectromagnet rinoenderana nesimba recurrent nenhamba yekuputira coil.
20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.1: Kana current yakasimba, magnetic field inova yakasimba.
20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o0: Kubatanidza mamwe mabhatiri mu series kuti current ifambe zvakasimba
20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o1: Kuderedza kuputira waya yeenamel kuita katsi makumi maviri
20261121-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o3: Kubvisa msumari wesimbi tichiisa chigubhu chemuti

20261122-physics-g06-1.title: Kushandisa kwepamusoro
20261122-physics-g06-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Kushandisa kwepamusoro kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-physics-g06-1.material: [Kushandisa kwepamusoro] Kana magirazi ekukudza (convex lens) akaswederwa pedyo zvikuru nemagwaro ephepanhau, magwaro anoonekwa makuru uye akamira zvakanaka, asi kana akabviswa kure, magwaro anoonekwa akadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi. Chii chinoita kuti aonekwe akamira zvakanaka paari pedyo?
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kushandisa kwepamusoro] Kana magirazi ekukudza (convex lens) akaswederwa pedyo zvikuru nemagwaro ephepanhau, magwaro anoonekwa makuru uye akamira zvakanaka, asi kana akabviswa kure, magwaro anoonekwa akadzoserwa kumusoro-pasi. Chii chinoita kuti aonekwe akamira zvakanaka paari pedyo?
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.explain: Kana chinhu chiri mukati me focal length ye convex lens, mitsetse yakatambanudzwa yechiedza chakatyoka inosangana ichigadzira virtual image ine hukuru kupfuura chinhu uye yakamira (magnified upright virtual image).
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: Fungai nzira yechiedza kana chinhu chiri pedyo kupfuura focal length.
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.hint.1: Chiedza chinopararira, saka mitsetse inofanira kutambanudzwa kumashure kwe lens kuti isangane.
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o0: Nokuti magwaro ari mukati me focal length ye lens, saka tinoona virtual image yakamira yakakudzwa
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o1: Nokuti chiedza chinoreflect sepagirazi pamusoro pe lens
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o3: Nokuti mhute iri mumhepo yakapisa lens yemagirazi ekukudza

20261122-physics-g06-2.title: Chii chikonzero chesainzi nei
20261122-physics-g06-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Chii chikonzero chesainzi nei kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-physics-g06-2.material: Chii chikonzero chesainzi nei zvisingatenderwi kubata plug yemagetsi kana switch yemidziyo yemumba nemaoko akanyorova?
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: Chii chikonzero chesainzi nei zvisingatenderwi kubata plug yemagetsi kana switch yemidziyo yemumba nemaoko akanyorova?
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.explain: Kana ganda richinyorova, resistance yemagetsi yemuviri inoderera zvakanyanya kuita chikamu chimwe pamakumi echenguva dzose, saka kunyangwe voltage duku inogona kuita current inouraya inopfuura nemuviri, ichiita kurovererwa nemagetsi.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.0: Mvura yezuva nezuva, kusiyana nemvura yakachena, ine electrolytes dzakanyungudutswa.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.1: Maoko akanyorova anoderedza resistance yeganda zvikuru, saka current inofamba nyore.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o0: Nokuti ions dzemaminerari dzakanyungudutswa mumvura dzinoita kuti magetsi apfuure nyore, uye njodzi yekurovererwa nemagetsi inowedzera zvikuru
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o1: Nokuti madonhwe emvura anotonhodza plug ichiita chando
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o2: Nokuti maoko akanyorova anogadzira simba remagineti
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o3: Nokuti magetsi anoita kuti mvura iri pamaoko ipere yose
